advice_items.quote: it kind of goes back to like the fail fast method um I would drop clothes literally every week ... nobody's waiting for six months for your big project
advice_items.summary_en: Use a fail-fast approach by launching weekly instead of spending six months trying to perfect one project.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每周高频上新快速试错，而非苦磨半年

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Break Big Goals Into Small Multiples
advice_items.quote: money is a game it's a game of doubles um it's a game of numbers ... all you have to do is make ten thousand ten times to get to a hundred and then make a hundred ten times get to a million
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid getting overwhelmed by seven-figure targets by breaking $1M down into repeatable 10x milestones.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把百万目标拆解为十个十万的倍数来推进

advice_items.quote: I never use any ads or any budget to necessarily Propel my work I feel like it was more like bootstrapping
advice_items.summary_en: Bootstrap early operations without relying on paid ad budgets to force organic traction.
advice_items.summary_zh: 零广告预算冷启动，靠自力更生打磨业务

advice_items.quote: we just have to understand that we got to show up yeah so consistency was everything
advice_items.summary_en: Show up in the field every single day regardless of obstacles; consistency drives growth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天坚持到场执行，保持高度一致性

advice_items.quote: don't push because when you push it makes them seem like you need them ... I'd rather be so good and so massive that people come to me and I'm selecting who's able
advice_items.summary_en: Never chase or pressure prospects; build enough value and exclusivity that customers come to you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售切忌硬推，用实力与稀缺感吸引客户

advice_items.quote: you're a product your environment ... I always want to be around people who are doing what I'm doing or more
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with peers performing at or above your level so you stay challenged and avoid complacency.
advice_items.summary_zh: 置身比自己更优秀的圈层，避免安于现状

advice_items.quote: focusing on yourself and investing in yourself is the biggest easiest way to get into those rooms so instead of going into the room with your hand out you're going into the room with something to offer
advice_items.summary_en: Sharpen a valuable skill first so you enter high-level rooms offering mutually beneficial expertise rather than asking for favors.
advice_items.summary_zh: 社交先提升自身技能，带着交换价值入局

advice_items.quote: whatever money that you receive you use it to buy assets that make you more money so it's like you get money and then you buy more money
advice_items.summary_en: Reinvest earned cash into income-producing assets so your money continuously buys more money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用赚到的钱持续购入能生钱的资产

advice_items.quote: careful selection with what you use your time on I think time is worth more than money ... it's so easy to pick the easier things ... versus the boring consistent and simple things
advice_items.summary_en: Value time above money by staying disciplined and choosing the boring, high-leverage fundamentals over flashy distractions.
advice_items.summary_zh: 珍惜时间胜过金钱，自律深耕枯燥核心事

advice_items.quote: social media marketing is like the number one Catalyst if you're trying to scale a business from zero to a million
advice_items.summary_en: Master social media marketing as the highest-leverage catalyst for scaling a business from $0 to $1M.
advice_items.summary_zh: 掌握社媒营销，低成本撬动百万级增长

advice_items.quote: start a short form business car detailing or something like that just to stack up my funds ... once I stack that up that I can dive back into like digital
advice_items.summary_en: If starting from zero, launch a quick cash-flow service business like car detailing to stack capital before scaling into digital ventures.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从零起步先做汽车精洗攒现金流再转线上
